task: reviewer-requested statistics (step9c): (A) permutation test for 16/217 local wins; (B) paired bootstrap transfer vs in-situ AUROC difference
seed_system: master seed 20261022 (step8b/step9b system); independent derived Generator per sub-test

test_A_local_wins_permutation.primary_method: null = per-perturbation scores of the two models are independent (pairing broken): permute scGenePT scores B=10000, statistic #(S_perm > G); one-sided p = (1+#{>=obs})/(B+1)
test_A_local_wins_permutation.primary_definition: step7 archived-labels comparison (GEARS labels: outputs/predictions_seed0.csv, its own 5000-gene space; scGenePT labels: scgenept_k562_labels.csv), common 217 perturbations — the source of the '16/217' and '9.7%' claims
test_A_local_wins_permutation.interpretation: observed 16 wins lies FAR BELOW the independence-null mean (~34): the two models' per-perturbation scores are positively associated, so random overlap would predict MORE wins than observed. The 16 wins are neither an excess of structure nor an artifact of overlap noise.

sensitivity_step7b_unified_space.definition: both models' pearson_delta recomputed on the unified 4813-gene public space from h5ad truth (step7b load_all)

test_A_local_wins_permutation.criterion: p < 0.05 → 局部优胜成结构（特定扰动系统性属于 scGenePT），'噪声'解释被排除，oracle headroom 真实但难回收 | p >= 0.05 → 16/217 不构成超出独立重叠的优胜；若观察值还低于零分布均值，则独立性本身被反向拒绝（两模型分数正相关），'噪声化'方向与审稿人假设相反
test_A_local_wins_permutation.verdict: 独立零假设下仅分布重叠就期望 ≈34/217 个优胜（零分布均值 33.7），观察 16 显著低于该期望（下侧 p=1.0e-04，双侧 p=2.0e-04）——两模型逐扰动分数正相关（同难同易），独立性本身被反向拒绝。审稿人'16/217 可能是噪声'的担忧方向相反：随机重叠会产生更多（≈34）而非更少的优胜，16 不构成超额优胜，也不是重叠噪声的产物；但'特定扰动系统性属于 scGenePT'同样未被本检验支持（16 是低于独立期望的值，不是超额结构）。Discussion 中'赢点在内部表示'的表述需据此收敛为：局部反转真实存在但数量受配对结构约束（≈16/217），可回收 headroom 仅 2.7%。

oracle_headroom_anchor.note: even if structured, headroom is only ~2.7% of the all-GEARS level → does not change the main conclusion

test_B_transfer_vs_insitu_paired_bootstr.label: y = (1 - pearson_delta) > median over all 306 RPE1 perturbations (step6d load_dataset, same as step9b)
test_B_transfer_vs_insitu_paired_bootstr.transfer_scores: archived K562 deployment probe (outputs/gating_probe_transfer.json) applied verbatim, no refit (step9b logic)
test_B_transfer_vs_insitu_paired_bootstr.insitu_scores: step8b-spec in-situ refit on all 306 RPE1 (StandardScaler + LogisticRegression C=1.0, max_iter=2000, in-sample); coef max|dev| vs archived outputs_rpe1/gating_probe_transfer.json = 0.0e+00
test_B_transfer_vs_insitu_paired_bootstr.unit: perturbation-level resampling, both score vectors fixed (no refit), AUROC_transferred − AUROC_insitu
test_B_transfer_vs_insitu_paired_bootstr.criterion: CI 全 < 0 → detection transfers with a small, significant degradation | CI 跨 0 → statistically indistinguishable
test_B_transfer_vs_insitu_paired_bootstr.verdict: CI 全 < 0 → detection transfers with a small, significant degradation
